The custom of burning incense has a long history in China.Usually people incense their clothes for etiquette.Ancient scholars also like to burn a furnace in the study to create a mood of "red sleeves and fragrance for night reading".Therefore, it was long before the Han Dynasty.Incense burners made of pottery, porcelain, copper, iron, and tiles appeared.During the Han Dynasty, the introduction of Buddhism played a significant role in the development of incense burners.From the end of the Yuan Dynasty to the beginning of the Ming, incense burners made of other materials gradually It was replaced by a copper incense burner, and the Xuande period of the Ming Dynasty was the peak period of copper incense burner production.

Price monopoly refers to behaviors in which operators engage in collusion or abuse of market dominance, manipulate the market to regulate prices, disrupt normal production and operation orders, damage the legitimate rights and interests of other operators or consumers, or endanger public interests.

Question: According to the above definitions, Which of the following are not price monopoly actions:

choices.B: In order to attract customers, some shopping malls sell some products below the cost price.
choices.C: The factory with the patent right relies on the dominant market position to enforce the resale price when the dealer picks up the goods
